jobs.title: Product Manager - Brokerage - EU
jobs.description:
Who We Are:

Alpaca is a US-headquartered, global leader in agent-first brokerage infrastructure  for stocks, ETFs, options, crypto, fixed income, 24/5 trading, and more.

Amongst our subsidiaries, Alpaca is a licensed financial services company, serving hundreds of financial institutions across 40 countries with our institutional-grade APIs. This includes broker-dealers, investment advisors, wealth managers, hedge funds, and crypto exchanges, totalling over 10 million brokerage accounts.

Our global team is a diverse group of experienced engineers, traders, and brokerage professionals who are working to achieve our mission of opening financial services to everyone on the planet. We're deeply committed to open-source contributions and fostering a vibrant community, continuously enhancing our award-winning, developer-friendly API and the robust infrastructure behind it.

Alpaca is proudly backed by $400 million in funding from top-tier global investors including Portage Ventures, Spark Capital, Tribe Capital, Social Leverage, Horizons Ventures, Opera Tech Ventures, SBI Group, Derayah Financial, Unbound, Peak XV, Elefund, and Y Combinator.

Our Team Members:

We're a dynamic team of 400+ globally distributed members who thrive working from our favorite places around the world, with teammates spanning the USA, Canada, Japan, Hungary, Nigeria, Brazil, the UK, and beyond!

We're searching for passionate individuals eager to contribute to Alpaca's rapid growth. If you align with our core values—Stay Curious, Have Empathy, and Be Accountable—and are ready to make a significant impact, we encourage you to apply.

Your Role:

Alpaca is building the infrastructure layer that partners across Europe use to launch and scale brokerage products. We're expanding our EU footprint - with growing market access, a regional roadmap, and ambitions across equities, ETFs, derivatives, direct connectivity, securities lending, tax reporting, and tax-wrapper products. We're hiring a Product Manager to own that expansion end-to-end: define the strategy, ship the products, and work with regulators, partners, and internal teams to make Alpaca the brokerage platform of choice across the EU.

We're seeking a Product Manager to define and drive new product initiatives and manage a portfolio of existing products across EU markets. With a deep understanding of the regional regulatory landscape, including MiFID II / MiFIR, ESMA, CSDR, national competent-authority frameworks, and member-state tax and tax-wrapper regimes, you will shape the product strategy that enables Alpaca to scale its brokerage infrastructure across the EU.

This role is equal parts strategy and delivery. You'll decide what we build versus buy, how we sequence the region’s roadmap, and which partnerships and connectivity paths get us there - and then ship the brokerage features, tax-wrapper functionality, integrations, and operational workflows that partners and institutional clients depend on every day.

What You'll Walk Into

You won't be starting from zero. You'll be owning live problems:

- EU market access: scaling from initial access to full product coverage while meeting MiFID II / MiFIR, ESMA, and local NCA requirements.

- The rest of the EU roadmap: prioritizing and delivering the next wave of brokerage capabilities across equities, ETFs, and regional market needs.

- EU direct connectivity: building and owning connectivity to EU venues and market infrastructure, reducing reliance on intermediary paths.

- EU broker partnerships: evaluating, onboarding, and integrating local brokers to expand coverage and resilience.

- Cross-border complexity: passporting, multi-jurisdiction onboarding, and coordinating between Alpaca's global platform and EU market infrastructure.

- Tax and tax wrappers: building tax-wrapper account functionality (e.g. PEA / PEA-PME, ISK, PIR) and the tax surface underneath it - tax lots / cost basis, dividend withholding, WHT reclaim, and country-specific tax reporting - so partners can offer jurisdiction-specific wrappers on Alpaca, not just a generic brokerage account.

Things You Get To Do

- Own brokerage products tailored for EU markets, including equities, ETFs, tax-wrapper accounts, and related regional offerings.

- Own the EU tax and tax-wrapper product surface end-to-end: wrapper eligibility and contribution rules, tax-lot / cost-basis tracking, withholding and reclaim, and the local reporting files partners and end-users need to stay compliant.

- Drive brokerage product strategy by analyzing ROI, regional market competition, regulatory requirements, and build-vs-buy scenarios.

- Build and execute the product roadmap with a focus on MiFID II / MiFIR-compliant features and regional market needs.

- Write product requirements and work with engineers to execute programs that meet local regulatory and market standards.

- Improve brokerage operation efficiency by providing solutions and owning the metrics, with a focus on regional settlement, custody, and clearing workflows.

- Lead customer calls around brokerage process and product issues to gain insights and translate them into product improvements for EU clients.

- Report timely and accurately on product status and results to internal and external stakeholders, including regional partners and institutional clients.

- Collaborate with local operations teams to ensure seamless integration between Alpaca's global platform and EU market infrastructure.

Who You Are (Must-Haves)

- Excited about what Alpaca is building and passionate about expanding financial infrastructure across the EU.

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, finance, or equivalent.

- 5+ years of experience in Product Management, Engineering, Consulting, and/or starting a startup, preferably within financial services or fintech.

- Demonstrated interest and experience in brokerage, capital markets, or fintech within the EU.

- Strong understanding of MiFID II / MiFIR, ESMA, the EU capital markets landscape, and how member-state tax and tax-wrapper rules shape product design.

- Strong communication skills in English, both written and verbal, with excellent collaboration abilities.

- Business acumen to understand tradeoffs between stakeholders and technology feasibility with time and budget constraints.

Who You Might Be (Nice-to-Haves)

- Experience and background working on and developing brokerage products in EU markets.

- Technical background working with APIs, particularly in financial services or trading platforms.

- Familiarity with CSDR, EMIR, T2S, or CSD connectivity.

- Hands-on experience shipping tax-wrapper or tax-reporting products (e.g. PEA / PEA-PME, ISK, PIR), including tax lots, withholding, and local reporting files.

- Experience working with cross-border / passporting investment products.

- Additional EU language(s) beyond English.

- Experience working at a fintech, startup, or EU-authorized investment firm.

How We Take Care of You:

- Competitive Salary & Stock Options

- Health Benefits

- New Hire Home-Office Setup: One-time USD $500

- Monthly Stipend: USD $150 per month via a Brex Card

Alpaca is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace dedicated to pursuing and hiring a diverse workforce.

jobs.description:
Who We Are:

Alpaca is a US-headquartered, global leader in agent-first brokerage infrastructure  for stocks, ETFs, options, crypto, fixed income, 24/5 trading, and more.

Amongst our subsidiaries, Alpaca is a licensed financial services company, serving hundreds of financial institutions across 40 countries with our institutional-grade APIs. Our global team is a diverse group of experienced engineers, traders, and brokerage professionals who are working to achieve our mission of opening financial services to everyone on the planet. We're deeply committed to open-source contributions and fostering a vibrant community, continuously enhancing our award-winning, developer-friendly API and the robust infrastructure behind it.

Alpaca is proudly backed by $400 million in funding from top-tier global investors including Portage Ventures, Spark Capital, Tribe Capital, Social Leverage, Horizons Ventures, Opera Tech Ventures, SBI Group, Derayah Financial, Unbound, Peak XV, Elefund, and Y Combinator.

Our Team Members:

We're a dynamic team of 400+ globally distributed members who thrive working from our favorite places around the world, with teammates spanning the USA, Canada, Japan, Hungary, Nigeria, Brazil, the UK, and beyond!

We're searching for passionate individuals eager to contribute to Alpaca's rapid growth. If you align with our core values—Stay Curious, Have Empathy, and Be Accountable—and are ready to make a significant impact, we encourage you to apply.

Your Role

Alpaca is building the next generation of global brokerage and clearing infrastructure. We are looking for a senior product manager who can own the clearing systems product lifecycle at a rapidly scaling self-clearing broker-dealer.

Your mission is to build and operate the systems and processes that keep Alpaca accurate, compliant, and on time across areas like core brokerage, clearing, ledger, custody, money movement, and multi-currency infrastructure. You will make clearing scale reliably as Alpaca adds asset classes, account types, trading hours, and partner institutions, and as we run a true self-clearing book at DTCC, OCC, and FICC.

This person should be able to walk into ambiguity, understand the full clearing lifecycle, design the architecture, build a working prototype, and lead a team toward production-grade infrastructure. The role sits at the intersection of product, engineering, operations, finance, compliance, and regulatory infrastructure.

What You’ll Own

You will lead the design and buildout of Alpaca’s core clearing infrastructure across brokerage, custody, ledger, asset movement, and global market expansion.

This includes:

- Defining the long-term architecture for Alpaca’s clearing platform across accounts, positions, balances, ledgers, journals, settlements, stock record, and regulatory books and records.

- Designing multi-currency cash and position systems that can support global equities, FX, fractional trading, options, bonds, Treasuries, fixed income, mutual funds, and other asset classes.

- Partnering with engineering to prototype and build new clearing services rather than relying only on third-party service bureau workflows.

- Working cross-functionally with operations, finance, treasury, compliance, legal, risk, and product to ensure the platform is scalable, controlled, and regulator-ready.

- Translating complex clearing, custody, and regulatory requirements into clear product and engineering requirements.

- Helping Alpaca grow from U.S.-centric brokerage infrastructure into a global, multi-asset, multi-currency clearing platform.

Who You Are (Must-Haves)

- 5+ years in Product Management, technical program management, or engineering on brokerage, clearing, or post-trade infrastructure.

- 10+ years of experience in brokerage, clearing, custody, prime brokerage, trading infrastructure, financial market infrastructure, or capital markets technology.

- Demonstrated depth on at least one clearing surface: settlement and stock record, books and records, corporate actions, margin, ACATS, DTCC processing.

- Highly technical. Ability to work directly with engineers and product teams to turn complex domain requirements into scalable system designs.

- Comfort shipping in parallel with Compliance, Legal, and Operations in a regulated broker-dealer environment.

- Strong operating judgment  to weigh risk, operational efficiency, capital allocation, tech feasibility, time, and budget.

- Experience leading senior teams and influencing across functions in a high-growth environment.

Who You Might Be (Nice-to-Haves)

- You helped build, convert, or modernize corporate-action processing, a security master, or a self-clearing back office.

- Experience with global brokerage expansion, including international equities, FX, local market custody, omnibus models, sub-ledgers, and currency controls.

- Familiarity with the B2B2C correspondent / broker-as-a-service model.

- AI-native PM workflow: recurring use of tools like Cursor, Claude, ChatGPT, or custom agents in PRD drafting, incident synthesis, data exploration, and prototyping.

Example Problems You Should Be Comfortable Solving

- How should stock record reconcile to DTC, custodians, omnibus providers, internal ledgers, trading systems, and customer-facing balances?

- How should global equities, FX, fractional shares, options, fixed income, Treasuries, and mutual funds fit into one clearing architecture?

- How should a multi-currency brokerage ledger represent trades, settlements, FX conversions, fees, financing, journals, and custody balances?

- How should cashiering, ACH, wires, ACATS, journals, reversals, and transfer exceptions be represented in ledger and operations systems?

- How should possession or control, segregation, fully paid lending, margin, reserve, and reconciliation controls be embedded into the platform instead of handled as manual after-the-fact processes?

How We Take Care of You:

- Competitive Salary & Stock Options

- Health Benefits

- New Hire Home-Office Setup: One-time USD $500

- Monthly Stipend: USD $150 per month via a Brex Card

Alpaca is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace dedicated to pursuing and hiring a diverse workforce.

Your Role:

Alpaca is already the infrastructure layer that hundreds of partners build on for execution. Nobody else is both the execution layer and the data layer - and that makes us the natural one-stop shop for brokerage plus market data. We're hiring a Lead Product Manager to own that second half: define and grow Alpaca's market data business as a standalone, revenue-generating product line.

We're seeking a Lead Product Manager, Market Data to define and own Alpaca's market data strategy - both as a capability that powers our platform and as a standalone, revenue-generating product line.

This role is equal parts strategy and delivery. You'll decide what data we source, how we package and price it, what we build versus buy - and then ship the APIs, feeds, and tooling that partners and internal teams depend on every day.

What You'll Walk Into

You won't be starting from zero - you'll be owning live problems:

- Multiple new exchange onboardings in flight, each with its own licensing, entitlement, and redistribution constraints.

- A pricing and packaging model that needs rethinking as we expand across asset classes and geographies.

- Partners asking for data we don't serve yet - consolidated feeds, historical datasets, derived analytics - you'll be building those requests against cost and commercial upside.

- Internal teams (trading, algo routing, compliance, clearing) consuming market data with no product owner ensuring coverage keeps pace.

Things You Get To Do

- Negotiate or inform negotiations on exchange licensing, redistribution rights, and entitlements as Alpaca onboards new exchanges and asset classes - you'll talk to vendors and global venues directly.

- Assess build-vs-buy for data infrastructure: where do we source from third parties, where do we invest in proprietary collection and normalization, and where do we create derived or value-added data products.

- Build the commercial model: define pricing and packaging (real-time vs. delayed, depth-of-book tiers, historical datasets, derived analytics) and work with sales to grow market data revenue.

- Own the competitive position: understand how dedicated market data providers price and differentiate, and identify where Alpaca's bundled brokerage-plus-data model creates a defensible edge.

- Own the developer experience for market data APIs (REST, WebSocket/SSE, historical endpoints) - coverage, latency, reliability, and documentation that developers actually want to read.

- Lead partner discovery: understand what data capabilities are table-stakes vs. differentiating for neobrokers, RIAs, hedge funds, and crypto exchanges, and turn that into prioritization.

jobs.description:
Who We Are:

Alpaca is a US-headquartered, global leader in agent-first brokerage infrastructure  for stocks, ETFs, options, crypto, fixed income, 24/5 trading, and more.

Amongst our subsidiaries, Alpaca is a licensed financial services company, serving hundreds of financial institutions across 40 countries with our institutional-grade APIs. This includes broker-dealers, investment advisors, wealth managers, hedge funds, and crypto exchanges, totalling over 10 million brokerage accounts.

Our global team is a diverse group of experienced engineers, traders, and brokerage professionals who are working to achieve our mission of opening financial services to everyone on the planet. We're deeply committed to open-source contributions and fostering a vibrant community, continuously enhancing our award-winning, developer-friendly API and the robust infrastructure behind it.

Alpaca is proudly backed by $400 million in funding from top-tier global investors including Portage Ventures, Spark Capital, Tribe Capital, Social Leverage, Horizons Ventures, Opera Tech Ventures, SBI Group, Derayah Financial, Unbound, Peak XV, Elefund, and Y Combinator.

Our Team Members:

We're a dynamic team of 400+ globally distributed members who thrive working from our favorite places around the world, with teammates spanning the USA, Canada, Japan, Hungary, Nigeria, Brazil, the UK, and beyond!

We're searching for passionate individuals eager to contribute to Alpaca's rapid growth. If you align with our core values—Stay Curious, Have Empathy, and Be Accountable—and are ready to make a significant impact, we encourage you to apply.

Your Role:
We're looking for a Senior Data Scientist, Product to help shape Alpaca's products through rigorous product analytics, experimentation, and data-informed strategy. You'll be a senior individual contributor embedded with Product, Engineering, and Design—turning ambiguous product questions into clear insight, defining the metrics that matter, and building the experimentation tooling that lets teams decide what we build next. Your work will directly influence the roadmap, improve the developer and end-user experience across our partners, and uncover new growth and monetization opportunities across our 10M+ brokerage accounts.

This role is ideal for someone with a strong product analytics background who thrives cross-functionally, loves experimentation and causal inference, and wants meaningful ownership over how data drives product decisions at a fast-growing, global brokerage-infrastructure company. As we build a more agentic Alpaca, you'll also help make analytics self-serve for the whole company.

What You'll Do

- Drive product strategy with analytics. Perform deep-dive analyses across the product funnel (onboarding, KYC, funding, trading) to identify growth opportunities and drive improvements in core product and business metrics.

- Build the experimentation engine. Design and build the tooling, frameworks, and guardrails that empower teams to run trustworthy A/B experiments and causal-inference studies at scale—standardizing metrics, statistical methods, and self-serve analysis so the whole org can experiment with rigor and velocity.

- Define the metrics that matter. Define and maintain key product performance metrics; partner with analytics engineering to build governed, scalable metrics and dashboards that teams rely on every day.

- Embed cross-functionally. Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Design, Finance, and Operations to integrate data-driven decision-making into the product development lifecycle.

- Turn data into narrative. Create compelling data visualizations and narratives to communicate insights and recommendations to cross-functional partners, stakeholders, and senior leadership.

- Enable self-serve and agentic analytics. Help operationalize analytics—transitioning ad-hoc requests into intuitive self-serve environments and contributing to text-to-analytics on top of our semantic layer.

- Mentor and set standards. Mentor other data scientists and analysts, contribute to best practices, and help foster a data-informed product culture across the organization.

What We're Looking For

- Proven expertise in product analytics and data science, with a strong background in statistical analysis and experimentation.

- Experience building experimentation tooling and frameworks that empower teams to run trustworthy A/B tests and causal-inference analyses.

- Strong cross-functional collaboration and communication skills; able to influence product direction with both technical and non-technical partners.

- Strong programming skills in Python & SQL, or other relevant languages.

- Outstanding problem-solving skills and the ability to think critically and creatively.

- Experience with data visualization tools and techniques.

- Ability to successfully implement projects and compete in a fast-paced environment.

- PhD or master's degree in a quantitative field such as mathematics, statistics, engineering, economics, or natural sciences, and at least 6–10 years of experience developing and deploying predictive models.

How We Take Care of You:

- Competitive Salary & Stock Options

- Health Benefits

- New Hire Home-Office Setup: One-time USD $500

- Monthly Stipend: USD $150 per month via a Brex Card

Alpaca is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace dedicated to pursuing and hiring a diverse workforce.

Recruitment Privacy Policy

jobs.title: Senior Technical Product Manager: Infrastructure and Platforms

Who We Are:

Alpaca is a US-headquartered, global leader in agent-first brokerage infrastructure  for stocks, ETFs, options, crypto, fixed income, 24/5 trading, and more.

Amongst our subsidiaries, Alpaca is a licensed financial services company, serving hundreds of financial institutions across 40 countries with our institutional-grade APIs. This includes broker-dealers, investment advisors, wealth managers, hedge funds, and crypto exchanges, totalling over 10 million brokerage accounts.

Our global team is a diverse group of experienced engineers, traders, and brokerage professionals who are working to achieve our mission of opening financial services to everyone on the planet. We're deeply committed to open-source contributions and fostering a vibrant community, continuously enhancing our award-winning, developer-friendly API and the robust infrastructure behind it.

Alpaca is proudly backed by $400 million in funding from top-tier global investors including Portage Ventures, Spark Capital, Tribe Capital, Social Leverage, Horizons Ventures, Opera Tech Ventures, SBI Group, Derayah Financial, Unbound, Peak XV, Elefund, and Y Combinator.

Our Team Members:

We're a dynamic team of 400+ globally distributed members who thrive working from our favorite places around the world, with teammates spanning the USA, Canada, Japan, Hungary, Nigeria, Brazil, the UK, and beyond!

We're searching for passionate individuals eager to contribute to Alpaca's rapid growth. If you align with our core values—Stay Curious, Have Empathy, and Be Accountable—and are ready to make a significant impact, we encourage you to apply.

Your Role

Build Alpaca's internal infrastructure and developer platform as a product. You own the product definition and platform maturity strategy, the intake, the backlog, and the multi-quarter roadmap for Platform & Infrastructure, and you put the rails in place so DevOps, Platform, and Infrastructure teams, and the customers know what to prioritize next. Partnering directly with the VP of Engineering.

Alpaca is building infrastructure for programmable finance at global scale: new countries, global markets, products that must stay centralized, and products that must be deployable in any region. This seat exists so that work has a product owner — platform maturity, CI/CD, cost efficiency and attribution, and the infrastructure dependencies that product engineering keeps discovering too late.

Things You Get To Do

Own infrastructure as a product. Define and evolve a platform maturity model in the open. Internal customers are Alpaca engineers. The north star matches the Platform & Infrastructure charter: self-serve infrastructure on paved golden paths – any engineer can build, ship, authenticate, observe, and scale a service without filing a ticket. You are the product owner for Foundational Infrastructure inside the TPM team: efficiency ( cost attribution / chargeback ) and the KPIs that prove the platform is getting easier to consume ( full CI/CD delivery and adoption ).

Build the rails for monthly delivery. Teams already carve capacity for on-call, support, and upgrades. What remains is discovery and delivery. You make the next pull from a living roadmap obvious. You keep the central backlog and intake sane. You surface platform and infrastructure dependencies before they become surprises on someone else's roadmap.

Drive platform maturity until maintenance windows disappear. Short term you will feel the pain of coordinating maintenance windows, runbooks, and market-hours constraints — because you cannot eliminate what you have not operated. The goal is 24/7 deployability across open and closed markets, globally.

Make the cost a first-class product surface. Work with infrastructure engineering and Finance on attribution, chargeback, and efficiency. This requires technical judgment: you have to understand why a node, a database, or a pipeline costs what it costs. Cost is one program, not the whole job.

Raise CI/CD and developer-platform adoption. Full CI/CD delivery and adoption is a stated KPI for this seat. Partner with DevOps App (ArgoCD, service mesh, API gateway) and Platform (AuthX, event streaming, DevEx) so golden paths get used, not documented and ignored.

Make infrastructure portable for global scale. Distinguish what must stay centralized to serve all of Alpaca from what must be packaged and deployable in new markets Alpaca will expand to.

Who You Are (Must-Haves)

- 7+ years as a TPM, product manager technical, or equivalent, with a substantial portion of that time owning infrastructure, platform or developer experience.

- You have owned a multi-team backlog, intake, and roadmap, and you have run a planning cadence that teams actually use.

- You are technically fluent to be an equal partner to senior/staff engineers on compute infra, deployment pipelines (CI/CD), data stores, networking, and cost drivers. While you do not need to write production Terraform; you do need to know when a proposal is hand-wavy.

- You get things done without a reporting line. You have influenced platform adoption across many teams.

- You write and operate with crisp scope. You can say what this role does not own and still leave no gap.

- You have worked in a market-hours-sensitive or regulated production environment, or another domain where deploy windows, change risk, and customer trust are real constraints.

- You use AI and automation to remove program toil rather than add tooling.

Who You Might Be (Nice-to-Haves)

- You have stood up a platform-maturity model, paved-path program, or internal developer platform.

- You have eliminated or dramatically reduced maintenance windows or change-freeze culture in a production org.

- Multi-region or multi-entity infrastructure: packaging a platform so a new region or booking center can be stood up without a hero project.

- Capital markets, brokerage, or other FinTech infrastructure.

How We Take Care of You:

- Competitive Salary & Stock Options

- Health Benefits

- New Hire Home-Office Setup: One-time USD $500

- Monthly Stipend: USD $150 per month via a Brex Card

Alpaca is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace dedicated to pursuing and hiring a diverse workforce.

Recruitment Privacy Policy
